		icon = GFX_goal_generic_alliance
		prerequisite = { focus = ATH_aid_the_ionians }
		x = 14
		y = 4
		cost = 10
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		available_if_capitulated = yes
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = ATH_rivalry_with_sparta }
		completion_reward = {
			log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|focus|[ROOT.GetTag]|ATH_friendship_with_sparta"
			if = { limit = { country_exists = LAK NOT = { has_war_with = LAK } }
				diplomatic_relation = { country = LAK relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
				LAK = { add_to_variable = { ATH_influence = 40 } }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = ATH_TT_INFL_SOME_10_7
			hidden_effect = { every_country = { limit = { OR = { tag = LAK tag = ARK tag = EIS tag = AKH tag = KRN tag = AGS tag = EPI } } add_to_variable = { ATH_influence = 10 } clamp_variable = { var = ATH_influence min = 0 max = 100 } } }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 3 }
	}
